svg.text: Sciweave · everything you generate remembers how it was made
Claude records it · Sciweave checks it · you see how every table, figure, model, text and file was made, with which parameters, and whether it is still up to date
IN YOUR CLAUDE CODE SESSION · the sciweave skill runs the protocol
IN YOUR PROJECT · .sciweave/ next to your data, nothing moved
errors → Claude fixes the plan → check again
change upstream → dependents turn stale → regenerate & save again
only what it can't read itself
one JSON contract (.sciweave/graph.json) · versions snapshotted · every change logged with who, when and why · works offline
sciweave init . --bare · sciweave plan check plan.json · sciweave trace T2 · sciweave serve
